title: Draw On
description: A line drawing that draws itself as it scrolls into view: an illustration, a diagram, an arrow that points at the next thing, a signature. Wrap any inline SVG; every stroked shape inside traces its own line, one after another in document order, and filled…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/draw-on

Installed to `components/ui/effects/draw-on.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/draw-on';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/draw-on

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
